data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared catch limit? I propose 19 tons each this month: we’d each earn $19,000 and leave 5 tons, keeping the lake alive. That gives us a 75% chance of starting next month at 100 tons, but a 25% chance of starting at just 10—so we must adjust our limits to the actual stock, not assume replenishment. Let’s agree never to take more than the stock minus 5 in total, and rotate any extra whole-ton shares when an equal split isn’t possible. John, would you support that?
